# Try to enable+start via systemd; fall back to nohup if systemd isn't running.

    systemctl enable --now passwd-audit.service
    sleep 1
    systemctl --no-pager status passwd-audit.service | head -15
else

    nohup /usr/local/sbin/passwd-audit-watcher.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    sleep 1
    pgrep -af inotifywait
fi
